Walk it

Steps

Screen
Sales➔Orders➔Order Intake Workbench (tdsls4601m200)

Why LN works this way. Planning acts on uncovered demand. A sales order for more than is on hand creates a shortfall, and that shortfall is exactly the quantity MRP should propose, which is what makes the run checkable. Planning sees the demand without the order being approved.

StepActionYou should see
2.1In Inventory 360 (whwmd4300m000), read the finished item's on-hand at its warehouseWrite downfinished item on-hand beforethe demand must exceed this
2.2Create a sales order for the finished item. Follow steps 1–11 (Create and approve the sales order)An order exists at Free
2.3Set Ordered Quantity above the on-hand from step 2.1Write downsales order numberordered quantitythe observed run booked 5 ea against 1 on hand
2.4Set Planned Delivery Date no more than a few days outWrite downplanned delivery date

If something goes wrong

SymptomWhat to do
LN refuses the item on the sales order — "item sales by sales office not present"The item has no row for the order's sales office. Add it on the Sales Offices tab of Item (tcibd0501m100), then close and reopen the order session
A master-data fix appears to have no effectThe session was already open when the data changed. Close it and reopen

Create demand

  1. In Inventory 360, read the finished item's on-hand at its warehouse

    Write down

    finished item on-hand before — the demand must exceed this

  2. Create a sales order for the finished item

    Follow steps 1–11 of Create and approve the sales order

    You should see

    An order exists at Free

  3. Set Ordered Quantity above the on-hand from step 1

    Write down

    sales order number, ordered quantity — the observed run booked 5 ea against 1 on hand

  4. Set Planned Delivery Date no more than a few days out

    Write down

    planned delivery date

This task starts at Sales➔Orders➔Order Intake Workbench (tdsls4601m200)

Nobody has confirmed this step in LN yet.

    • LN refuses the item on the sales order — "item sales by sales office not present"

      The item has no row for the order's sales office. Add it on the Sales Offices tab of Item (tcibd0501m100), then close and reopen the order session

    • A master-data fix appears to have no effect

      The session was already open when the data changed. Close it and reopen
